notes: DeepSeek Harness TUI maps a running-turn Ctrl+C to agent.cancel({kind:"user"}). The official agent loop persists turn/end with reason.kind=aborted and nested user cause; the DSH parser maps every non-error turn/end to turn_done. The lifecycle asserts a single-birth ready to working to ready interrupt arc and a second clean ready to working to ready recovery arc on the same session. Transcript assertions make the pass non-vacuous: they require the exact long prompt, exactly one user-caused aborted boundary, the exact recovery prompt, and exactly one completed boundary. A natural first-turn completion or a dropped interrupt cannot pass. The driver pins qwen/qwen3.5-9b through its temporary LM Studio patch. The recovery turn supplies non-zero token usage; local-route cost can remain zero.
